items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins, he had been over in Europe and he stayed there a long time... Coleman Hawkins changed that instrument... Coleman Hawkins and Benny Carter pulled out the tenor saxophone and started to playing it

ctx.x: This was around '38 and '39. I had been used to working and my attitude had changed, I had become Europeanized. I saw things from a different perspective. Why wasn't this man getting what he should get? Coleman Hawkins, he had been over in Europe and he stayed there a long time and they was having jam sessions but the people weren't getting paid and I saw poverty all in Harlem. When I left they were coming out from under
that era of poverty and they were trying to do things good and downtown, Birdland was moving nicely and things like that but when I come back it seemed like --
